claims: The first moon landing was launched by NASA's Apollo 11 mission on July 16, 1969.
The first moon landing was launched at 9:32 a.m. EDT.
The first moon landing was launched from Kennedy Space Center, Florida.
Astronauts Neil Armstrong, Buzz Aldrin, and Michael Collins flew aboard a Saturn V rocket.
NASA's Apollo 11 mission led to the first human step on the moon on July 20, 1969.
This video shows footage from the 1969 Apollo 11 moon landing
